# `underscore-private-name`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: official · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports declarations prefixed with `_` to suggest privacy.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Zig privacy is structural rather than name-based, so the prefix communicates a
contract the language does not enforce.

## When it fires

It is useful when migrating conventions from languages where underscore prefixes
control or conventionally mark visibility.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn _helper() void {}
```

Reference: <https://ziglang.org/documentation/master/#Refrain-from-Underscore-Prefixes>
